svg.text: llama_qwen_n16_jug_panic_t07: 16 cells, 40 hops. Colour = origin cell of the dominant distinctive words (grey = plain seed); inner bar = share of the new 4-grams (not in the cell itself at the previous hop) that were in the previous text of the left (dark) or right (light) neighbour; black dot = unchanged from previous hop.
